title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sun 08 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 08:30 to about 17:00. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,000 ft by the Kekoa camera, right on the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,200 ft, off by 200 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 09:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kahikinui stopped at 14:55; the Mesonet could not be reached on 16 of 54 updates.
